authority: Read ONLY from the trusted default-branch checkout by .github/workflows/ci_perf_guard.yml (workflow_run / schedule). A pull request's own copy of this file is never read while judging that pull request; a change here takes effect only after an owner merge.

baseline.note: Per-node regression baseline: authenticated hosted JUnit of CI V4 PR runs 44147228493 (head ac84868e, 2,284 nodes) and 44269408688 (accepted #458 head 8726d206, 1,903 nodes; later run wins), 2,433 nodes in all. The former single U1 waiver (976.9 s node) is retired: that node measured 80.8 s on run 44269408688. It is deliberately NOT docs/ci_v4/node_weights.json (a frozen V4 control whose U1 entries are ~6x stale). A node absent from the baseline is NEW: above new_node_without_baseline_seconds it fails until an owner-reviewed baseline refresh records it.

time_consistency.note: Sum of JUnit testcase times / authentic GitHub duration of the shard's test step. JUnit is written by pull-request code, so node-level numbers are attestations; every budget decision that can be decided from GitHub's own timestamps is decided from them, and JUnit that disagrees with them is PERFORMANCE_UNVERIFIED.

sweep.note: A scheduled sweep re-judges every open pull request's head; a head that is still pending once the end-to-end budget has elapsed becomes FAILURE, so a missing or stuck required run never leaves the status pending forever.
